scope: Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle (2nd ed.), Chapter 7: Unemployment in the New Keynesian Model, with Exercises 7.1-7.3. Indivisible labour and participation; the unemployment rate and the New Keynesian wage Phillips curve in unemployment; the equilibrium as the Chapter 6 system plus a static equation, with determinacy (the Chapter 6 four-variable theorem, restated); calibration, the labour-force wealth effect, unemployment fluctuations and wage rigidity; optimal policy; and the exercises.
source: Jordi Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle: An Introduction to the New Keynesian Framework and Its Applications, 2nd ed., Princeton University Press, 2015, Chapter 7, pp. 199-222.
